name: Tolins Tyres Limited
summary: Tolins Tyres Limited, established in 1982 and based in Aluva, India, produces and distributes tires and tread rubber. Tires cover two- and three-wheelers, light commercial vehicles and farm uses, and it supplies precured tread rubber and retreading materials such as bonding gum and curing bags. It exports to about 40 countries.
